messages.text: Hello there, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel, I'm BagelBot an AI Assistant, and How can I assist you today?
I want a bagel with cream cheese and sprinkles.

I don't see a bagel with cream cheese and sprinkles on our menu. Let me share some options: we have a Bagel with Spread, which includes various cream cheese flavors, and a Fruity Rice Crispy Treat that has colorful sprinkles. Would you like to hear more about either of these?
Tell me more about the bagel.
The Bagel with Spread includes a bagel of your choice topped with a variety of cream cheese flavors like plain, scallion, strawberry, jalapeño, honey almond, and more. You can also add extra toppings
Just regular cream cheese. Regular cream cheese. I'm a little crazy on me.

Got it! A Bagel with Spread featuring regular cream cheese is a great choice. You can pick your favorite bagel and enjoy it with plain cream cheese. Would you like to choose your bagel type now? We have options like plain,
Plain bagel plain bagel and cut it in thirds.
Sure thing! A plain bagel with plain cream cheese, cut into thirds. Is there anything else I can add to that for you?
